Messages.Body:
In article <6utqtj$c2t$1...@hubble.csuchico.edu>, Cy H. Myers
<cym...@ecst.csuchico.edu> writes
>If I do a Malk rider and the vote passes, can I then play
>cryptic rider/Charming Lobby on the vote I called?

The vote passes on their turn.

On your turn:

A) I call a vote. A vote passes, so Cryptic Rider is playable.

or

B) I play Charming Lobby which calls a vote (change back to Jyhad text
and intent) so it SHOULD pass because of the Malk rider.

No problems as I see it.
